name: That Girl Lola
overview: That Girl Lola is a family reality series streaming on We The Studios. Meet Lola, an ambitious 11-year-old juggling homeschool, dance, and a dream of fame. As she defies expectations and embraces her uniqueness, this heartwarming series shows the power of passion, authenticity, and hard work.
